tools.name: parse_visual
tools.purpose: Parse a chart, diagram, screenshot, or complex visual

tools.name: parse_document
tools.purpose: Fast extraction from a small document

tools.name: analyze_document
tools.purpose: Question-focused analysis of a long document

tools.name: analyze_document_v2
tools.purpose: Two-tier analysis of a complex or long document

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.purpose: Discover datasets, preferring ADS then DWS then DWD

tools.name: validate_query
tools.purpose: Validate a structured query plan; raw SQL is not accepted

tools.name: execute_query
tools.purpose: Execute only a previously validated query

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.purpose: Read the current snapshot and data version

tools.name: assess_training_data
tools.purpose: Assess suitability for model training, not general analytics

tools.name: inspect_review_gate
tools.purpose: Read and explain a frozen review-gate decision

tools.name: prepare_business_task
tools.purpose: Clarify and plan a vague business request; never execute it

tools.name: run_data_analysis
tools.purpose: Run complex analysis on trusted artifacts; simple aggregates belong in execute_query

tools.name: review_data_analysis
tools.purpose: Governed review of a completed analysis artifact

notes: Pipeline writes remain CLI/E2E-only and are not registered as default agent tools.
Legacy governance tool implementations are intentionally excluded from DATA_TOOL_FEATURES even when legacy flags are true.
Feature-disabled tools disappear from the registry; there are no stub tools.
